name: The Didache (Teaching of the Twelve Apostles)

o: Opens: “The Two Ways; The First Commandment”
ch.s: Verses 1–6: “There are two ways, one of life and one of death; but a great difference between the two ways.”.
q: Read verses 1–6. What is happening, and what stands out to you most?
Read verse 3 slowly. What does it say about God, about people, and about how to live?
Where do you see the theme of promise and blessing in this chapter, and how does it connect to the rest of The Didache (Teaching of the Twelve Apostles)?
What is one specific way you can put this chapter into practice this week?
ch.a: Do one concrete, unannounced act of love for someone in your home or church.

What is one specific way you can put this chapter into practice this week?

What is one specific way you can put this chapter into practice this week?
ch.a: Bring a present hardship to God and memorize the key verse as an anchor.
